audioManifest.reference: HE HAS GONE AND GONE FOR GOOD ANSWERED POLYCHROME WHO HAD MANAGED TO SQUEEZE INTO THE ROOM BESIDE THE DRAGON AND HAD WITNESSED THE OCCURRENCES WITH MUCH INTEREST

audioManifest.reference: I HAVE REMAINED A PRISONER ONLY BECAUSE I WISHED TO BE ONE AND WITH THIS HE STEPPED FORWARD AND BURST THE STOUT CHAINS AS EASILY AS IF THEY HAD BEEN THREADS

audioManifest.reference: THE LITTLE GIRL HAD BEEN ASLEEP BUT SHE HEARD THE RAPS AND OPENED THE DOOR

audioManifest.reference: THE KING HAS FLED IN DISGRACE AND YOUR FRIENDS ARE ASKING FOR YOU

audioManifest.reference: HE EATS AND SLEEPS VERY STEADILY REPLIED THE NEW KING

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-135031-0008

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-135031-0009
audioManifest.reference: HE DOESN'T WORK AT ALL

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-135031-0010
audioManifest.reference: IN FACT THERE IS NOTHING HE CAN DO IN THESE DOMINIONS AS WELL AS OUR NOMES WHOSE NUMBERS ARE SO GREAT THAT IT WORRIES US TO KEEP THEM ALL BUSY

audioManifest.reference: HAVING RETURNED TO THE ROYAL CAVERN KALIKO FIRST POUNDED THE GONG AND THEN SAT IN THE THRONE WEARING RUGGEDO'S DISCARDED RUBY CROWN AND HOLDING IN HIS HAND THE SCEPTRE WHICH RUGGEDO HAD SO OFTEN THROWN AT HIS HEAD

audioManifest.reference: A MAN SAID TO THE UNIVERSE SIR I EXIST

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0001
audioManifest.reference: SWEAT COVERED BRION'S BODY TRICKLING INTO THE TIGHT LOINCLOTH THAT WAS THE ONLY GARMENT HE WORE

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0002
audioManifest.reference: THE CUT ON HIS CHEST STILL DRIPPING BLOOD THE ACHE OF HIS OVERSTRAINED EYES EVEN THE SOARING ARENA AROUND HIM WITH THE THOUSANDS OF SPECTATORS WERE TRIVIALITIES NOT WORTH THINKING ABOUT

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0003
audioManifest.reference: HIS INSTANT OF PANIC WAS FOLLOWED BY A SMALL SHARP BLOW HIGH ON HIS CHEST

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0004
audioManifest.reference: ONE MINUTE A VOICE SAID AND THE TIME BUZZER SOUNDED

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0005
audioManifest.reference: A MINUTE IS NOT A VERY LARGE MEASURE OF TIME AND HIS BODY NEEDED EVERY FRACTION OF IT

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0006
audioManifest.reference: THE BUZZER'S WHIRR TRIGGERED HIS MUSCLES INTO COMPLETE RELAXATION

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0007
audioManifest.reference: ONLY HIS HEART AND LUNGS WORKED ON AT A STRONG MEASURED RATE

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0008
audioManifest.reference: HE WAS IN REVERIE SLIDING ALONG THE BORDERS OF CONSCIOUSNESS

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0009
audioManifest.reference: THE CONTESTANTS IN THE TWENTIES NEEDED UNDISTURBED REST THEREFORE NIGHTS IN THE DORMITORIES WERE AS QUIET AS DEATH

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0010
audioManifest.reference: PARTICULARLY SO ON THIS LAST NIGHT WHEN ONLY TWO OF THE LITTLE CUBICLES WERE OCCUPIED THE THOUSANDS OF OTHERS STANDING WITH DARK EMPTY DOORS

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0011
audioManifest.reference: THE OTHER VOICE SNAPPED WITH A HARSH URGENCY CLEARLY USED TO COMMAND

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0012
audioManifest.reference: I'M HERE BECAUSE THE MATTER IS OF UTMOST IMPORTANCE AND BRANDD IS THE ONE I MUST SEE NOW STAND ASIDE

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0013
audioManifest.reference: THE TWENTIES

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0014
audioManifest.reference: HE MUST HAVE DRAWN HIS GUN BECAUSE THE INTRUDER SAID QUICKLY PUT THAT AWAY YOU'RE BEING A FOOL OUT

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0015
audioManifest.reference: THERE WAS SILENCE THEN AND STILL WONDERING BRION WAS ONCE MORE ASLEEP

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0016
audioManifest.reference: TEN SECONDS

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0017
audioManifest.reference: HE ASKED THE HANDLER WHO WAS KNEADING HIS ACHING MUSCLES

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0018
audioManifest.reference: A RED HAIRED MOUNTAIN OF A MAN WITH AN APPARENTLY INEXHAUSTIBLE STORE OF ENERGY

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0019
audioManifest.reference: THERE COULD BE LITTLE ART IN THIS LAST AND FINAL ROUND OF FENCING

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0020
audioManifest.reference: JUST THRUST AND PARRY AND VICTORY TO THE STRONGER

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0021
audioManifest.reference: EVERY MAN WHO ENTERED THE TWENTIES HAD HIS OWN TRAINING TRICKS

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0022
audioManifest.reference: THERE APPEARED TO BE AN IMMEDIATE ASSOCIATION WITH THE DEATH TRAUMA AS IF THE TWO WERE INEXTRICABLY LINKED INTO ONE

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0023
audioManifest.reference: THE STRENGTH THAT ENABLES SOMEONE IN A TRANCE TO HOLD HIS BODY STIFF AND UNSUPPORTED EXCEPT AT TWO POINTS THE HEAD AND HEELS

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0024
audioManifest.reference: THIS IS PHYSICALLY IMPOSSIBLE WHEN CONSCIOUS

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0025
audioManifest.reference: OTHERS HAD DIED BEFORE DURING THE TWENTIES AND DEATH DURING THE LAST ROUND WAS IN SOME WAYS EASIER THAN DEFEAT

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0026
audioManifest.reference: BREATHING DEEPLY BRION SOFTLY SPOKE THE AUTO HYPNOTIC PHRASES THAT TRIGGERED THE PROCESS

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0027
audioManifest.reference: WHEN THE BUZZER SOUNDED HE PULLED HIS FOIL FROM HIS SECOND'S STARTLED GRASP AND RAN FORWARD

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0028
audioManifest.reference: IROLG LOOKED AMAZED AT THE SUDDEN FURY OF THE ATTACK THEN SMILED

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0029
audioManifest.reference: HE THOUGHT IT WAS A LAST BURST OF ENERGY HE KNEW HOW CLOSE THEY BOTH WERE TO EXHAUSTION

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0030
audioManifest.reference: BRION SAW SOMETHING CLOSE TO PANIC ON HIS OPPONENT'S FACE WHEN THE MAN FINALLY RECOGNIZED HIS ERROR

audioManifest.name: librispeech-1272-141231-0031
audioManifest.reference: A WAVE OF DESPAIR ROLLED OUT FROM IROLG BRION SENSED IT AND KNEW THE FIFTH POINT WAS HIS
